scope: Framed quadrilateral only; supplied boundary order agrees with the existing native vertex cycle.
geometric_seed: One of the two quadrilateral triangulations T, with supplied mark j in the diagonal set and positive rational additive mesh h.
channel_map: T -> delta_(v_T) in Z^2, v_T the canonical diagonal incidence vector.
carrier_map: T -> x_T=sum_{unordered diagonal {u,v} in T}(e_uv+e_vu)/2 in the existing twelve-arrow basis.
decoder: On this seed image, recover each diagonal coefficient as x_uv+x_vu; validate support and unit triangulation incidence before decoding.
native_square: Polygon quarter rotation rho=(A D B C) acts on T, mark and channel indices; the existing C12 acts on both endpoints of carrier arrows. x_(rho T)=C12 x_T.
access: Decode the full seed from retained (Kx,Nx), not from Kx alone; construct the finite packet and use retained-history-source-access.v1.
updates: Subsequent licensed packet operations use the full packet evaluator and contribution lineage. Carrier seed is immutable provenance; arbitrary heat/convolution are not native twelve-arrow updates.
fourier_boundary: C12 intertwines analytic comb Fourier under the old K attachment, but its geometric action here is polygon rotation, not channel Fourier. No identification of these two source operations.
